_note: Single source of truth for the GoStudio prompt library. Never hardcode prompt names, counts, or availability elsewhere — reference this file. If any other file disagrees, this file wins. Update as prompts publish.
_usage: Before writing copy that names or counts prompts, pull from here. Only status='live' prompts may appear in live copy. The prompts page is an SEO/AEO discovery surface — open, ungated, no account and no credits required to read (open decision D5, resolved 2026-08-19).
_maintenance: Created 2026-08-20, intentionally near-empty. Created because the data-file ownership table in the product marketing context already listed this file and it did not exist — an agent told to verify a figure against it would have stalled or invented one. Populate as prompts publish.
_schema_note: SAME FILE SHAPE AS templates.json (founder, 2026-08-20): a template record is a prompt record with more fields filled in. Fields that only templates need must be added as OPTIONAL fields on this shared shape, never as a fork — if the two files drift into different schemas, the product definition ('a template is a prompt that has been finished') and the data model stop agreeing, and the nomenclature section of the product marketing context becomes fiction.
_distribution: Prompts are published on GoStudio.ai AND on GitHub — the only acquisition surface not on our own domain. Both need the same onward path to templates and tools. Keeping the two in sync has no assigned owner yet; see work-log/TASKS.md.

columns.name: Customer-facing prompt name (2-3 words, evocative — same convention as templates.json)
columns.description: One line saying what you GET, not how it works
columns.model: Which handpicked model the prompt is written for — the prompts page is organised by model
columns.creator: Community creator credited, if any (see the creator revenue-share pillar)
columns.slug: URL slug if the prompt has a landing page (flat L1)
columns.github_path: Path in the public GitHub prompt library, if mirrored there

template_only_columns._note: Optional fields on the shared shape. Present on a record only once it has been finished into a template — their presence is what makes a record a template rather than a prompt.
template_only_columns.reference_images: Reference images, which the template definition requires (see the Prompts vs Templates vs Tools section of the product marketing context)
